How the quiz picks

  • Only tools checked in the last 30 days with a verified price and free tier (68 listings right now).
  • Free pick: the best free tier for your job that keeps working.
  • Paid pick: our highest-ranked tool whose cheapest monthly plan fits your budget.
  • Skip: the clearest reason in our data not to start there.
  • Affiliate deals never affect a pick. Nobody can pay for a spot.

How we check: every price and free tier on this page comes from the vendor's own pricing page, with the date we checked it. If we can't verify something, we say so. Found a wrong price? Email info@usethissi.com and we fix it within 24 hours.
